newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks mostly flat in London, Dow seen up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks mostly flat in London, Dow seen up.

text.p: U.S. stocks were narrowly mixed in thin trading in London on Tuesday, but dealers here were looking for a slightly better opening on Wall Street, after a three-day holiday weekend in the U.S.
In otherwise featureless dealings, shares in Philip Morris rose to $127-1/4 in London, up $1-3/4 from their New York close on Friday.

Dealers said the shares were bolstered as the company said a West Virginia judge dismissed the "essential claims" of the state attorney general's Medicaid reimbursement law suit against tobacco companies. Philip Morris said the ruling had implications for similar lawsuits in other states.
"It has been the main feature of the day, said one London dealer. "Besides Philip Morris, there's very little going on. Even the high tech stocks are very quiet. There's hardly been a trade."
The Dow on Friday eased on profit-taking, ending below the 7,000 mark at 6,988.96.
S&P 500 index futures rose in after-hours trading on Globex, with the March contract up 1.50 points to 813.75 at 1139 GMT.
No U.S. economic data are due today. --London newsroom
